card.name: Needle and contamination precaution wording
card.fires_on: The word "needle" after "prevent" or "possibility of" in needle-stick and breakage warnings. Also fires on "contamination" after "avoid", and inside "Precautions" and "pyrogenic".

modes.label: Needle hazards
modes.description: The word needle in needle-stick or needle breakage phrases.
modes.example: When a needle is connected to the syringe, to prevent<< needle>>-stick injuries, do not recap needles

modes.label: Avoiding contamination
modes.description: Words after "avoid" or "to avoid" in handling steps.
modes.example: first rinse out a sample bottle (to avoid<< contamination>> from other water)

modes.label: Inside precaution words
modes.description: Partway through words like Precautions or pyrogenic.
